data.title: EdCalibre
data.description: Interactive online learning and classroom gamification platform that transforms children's education through animated video lessons, chapter quizzes, and league leaderboards.
data.overview: Where education meets adventure! Our platform offers a dynamic blend of interactive lessons and quizzes, fostering a love for learning in children. With Edcalibre, kids can explore a world of knowledge while unlocking their full potential, all in a safe and engaging online environment.
highlights: Dynamic audio-visual learning paths with interactive lesson modules and video classrooms
Granular chapter and section score analytics with real-time performance milestones
Gamified student league leaderboards with achievement levels, badges, and points
Personalized student profile management with custom learning pace and subscription plans
